approvers: My wife (co-owner), our tax adviser and lawyer, my house bank
reason: The terms on paper are better than I expected, and a free first talk costs me nothing, so I will listen. But I have no successor, 13 people depend on me, and I will not hand over thirty years of work to a company with no track record and no one who has done this before.
objection: You have no track record, no sellers I can call, and I do not know who is really behind the money. If it goes wrong, my staff and my wife's retirement pay for it.
instead: Keep looking for an internal successor or a family handover, list quietly on nexxt-change, or talk to a known trade competitor or a regional buyer I can check.
would_change_my_mind: A bank letter my own adviser and my house bank have verified, named directors I can visit and check, and a first seller reference, or a respected trade colleague who vouches for them.
